name: ascii-profile-card
description: GitHub Action that generates Neofetch-style SVG profile cards with daily ASCII art and GitHub stats.
author: Ruslan Khasanshin

scripts.check:render: sh -eu -c 'output_dir=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ascii-profile-card.XXXXXXXX"); cleanup() { rm -rf -- "$output_dir"; }; trap cleanup EXIT; OUTPUT_DIR="$output_dir" CONFIG="$(cat example-config.yml)" bun generate; xmllint --noout "$output_dir/dark_mode.svg" "$output_dir/light_mode.svg"; grep -q "Mona Lisa Octocat" "$output_dir/dark_mode.svg"; grep -q "on GitHub" "$output_dir/light_mode.svg"'
scripts.check:all: bun lint && bun check:action && bun check:hooks && bun check:workflows && bun check && bun check:unused && bun run test && bun check:vulns && bun check:render
scripts.prepare: if [ -n "${CI:-}" ] || [ "${LEFTHOOK:-}" = "0" ]; then exit 0; fi; lefthook install
